title: 📍 FST sa Bacood
body:
🟢 Upcoming | Magkakaroon ng Funeral Service ang FST sa Bacood ngayong araw.
-------

📅 Iskedyul

7:00 PM – Meet-up at Church (CFC Compound)

7:30 PM – Departure from Church

8:00 PM – Service Time
-------

📌 Lugar

Holy Family Chapel – Ricass Court
Magtanggol St., Brgy. 617, Zone 61, Manila
-------

📋 Program Flow

1. Opening Remarks & Opening Prayer – Sis. Elvie Rosales

2. Praise & Worship – Sis. Jovelyn Quejano

3. Guest Speaker – Sis. Crisanta Estacio

4. Prayer for the Family – Sis. Crisanta Estacio

5. Tribute from Family and Friends

6. Closing Remarks & Closing Prayer – Bro. Erick De Guzman
-------

🚐 FST Service Vehicle
      Driver: Bro. Jessie Atibagos
-------

Paalala sa lahat ng nakatalaga: Mangyaring dumating sa tamang oras, makipag-coordinate sa inyong mga kasama, at ihanda ang sarili sa paglilingkod.
